definition: II. מָזוֺר noun masculine Obad 1:7 תַּחְתֶּיךָ ׳ יָשִׂימוּמ , very dubious, perhaps net (as something extended ): ᵐ5 ( ἔνεδρα ), ᵑ6 ᵑ9 ambush (? מָצוֺד or מְצוֺדָה net , Vollers ZAW 1884, 16 ; מָצוֺר siege Prince JBL xvi.1897, 177 ), Aq Theod fetter, bond , ᵑ7 ( תקלא ) stumbling-block ; Gr מַכְמֹר , מִכְמָר ; We Now leave untranslated; Dl Prol. 67, HWB 396 compare Assyrian mazûru , apparently a pole with an iron hook , but improbable — 1. מָזוֺר see below II. זוּר , p. 267. מִזְרֶה see זרה .
